title: New page in history? Xi, Trump and Putin summit was more of a footnote
summary_full: Far from the grand ambitions declared in Yalta in 1945, Shenzhen felt like a meeting in search of an agendaIt is arguably true, given it was the first such meeting of the leaders of China, Russia and the US, that Thursday’s gathering in Shenzhen deserved the description of “historic”.But in terms of tangible outcomes, it is unlikely to warrant the “new page in the history of diplomacy” that Vladimir Putin claimed had been written, and will instead be consigned to a smallish footnote in any future volume of the 21st century.
